title: Uramite
description: Uramite is a mod that adds many different things, such as weapons, blocks, mechanics and much more.
body:
This mod includes various items such as swords, weapons, “bombs,” blocks, armor, equipment, and mechanics.

**!!!It's recommended to use Just Enough Items OR EMI with this mod!!!**

This mod is mostly about uranium. New items that this mod will add.
- Uramite Ore
- Uramite Raw
- Uramite Ingot
- Uramite Rod
- Uramite Bomb
- Uramite Tools (Axe, Pickaxe, and Shovel)
- Sculk Sword (WIP)
- Ice Sword (WIP)
- Steel (Ingot, Block, Rod, Stair, Slab, Fence + Fence Gate, Trapdoor, and Pressure Plate)
- Ghost (Shadow Ghost): This ghost follows you around, but only watches and makes creepy noises.
- Shadow Ghost Soul
- BT-7274 Weapon (BT's weapon from Titanfall 2)
- BT-7274 Weapon LVL 2

Swords and Armaments
- “Battle-Axe”: A battle axe that can fire explosive projectiles with a right-click.
- Scythe: Heal the player with a right-click by removing hunger.
- Sculk Sword: A normal sword, but it CANNOT fire explosive projectiles.
- Ice Sword: No effects # normal sword.
- BT 7274 Weapon
- BT 7274 Weapon LVL 2 (modified)

![Preview of some Items](https://i.imgur.com/cTl6ie4.png)

- Terraria Swords (all normal swords with varying durability, no special effects)
- Zenith
- Soul Scythe
- Influx Waver
- Star Wrath
- Seedler
- Terra Blade

World Generation
- Tent
- Skyscraper
- Biome:Stony_shore House



Machines
- Solar Panel
- Battery
- Fan

Steel Blocks
- Steel Block
- Steel Stair
- Steel Slab
- Steel Fence + Fence gate
- Steel trapdoor
- Steel pressure plate

![Steel Blocks Preview](https://i.imgur.com/9PJsOcB.png)

Anime Content (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)
- Dios Stand “The World”: as material, “Zawarudo Ingot” can only be found in the End.
- Zawarudo Armor
- Zawarudo Powder

with Zawarudo Powder is it also possible do make Potions
